# experiment-tracker-lite

> File-based experiment tracker with a subset of the MLflow fluent API, run search with MLflow filter syntax and a reproducible static comparison site Python package `trysac-experiment-tracker-lite`, import name `experiment_tracker_lite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
